scaled.architecture: Pre-LN Scaled Transformer with Weight Tying

sample_translations_comparison.linguistic_notes: All three correctly identify this is about a government minister; only the baseline captures 'Haryana' (ହରିଆଣା). None fully match the reference on this terse, headline-style sentence -- a realistic example of the model's limits.

sample_translations_comparison.source: The residents of the locality are in a state of panic after the incident.
sample_translations_comparison.reference: ଏହି ଘଟଣା ପରେ ସ୍ଥାନୀୟ ଲୋକେ ଉତ୍ତେଜନା ପ୍ରକାଶ କରିଛନ୍ତି।
sample_translations_comparison.baseline_output: ଏହି ଘଟଣା ପରେ ସ୍ଥାନୀୟ ଅଞ୍ଚଳରେ ସେ ସୃଷ୍ଟି ଅଞ୍ଟାନ ସ୍ଟୀୟ ଲୋକେ ।
sample_translations_comparison.scaled_greedy: ଏହି ଘଟଣାରେ ପୁଲିସ୍ତାନାନେ ପ୍ରକାରୀଙ୍କୁ ଗ୍ୟାର କରୁଛି।
sample_translations_comparison.scaled_beam: ଏହି ଘଟଣାରେ ପୁଲିସ୍ଥିତ୍ରେ ଏହି ମାମଲାରୁ ଘଟିଛି ।
sample_translations_comparison.linguistic_notes: All three correctly produce 'after the incident' (ଏହି ଘଟଣା ପରେ/ରେ). The scaled model with beam search stays closest to a coherent full sentence; the baseline and scaled-greedy outputs trail off into less relevant phrasing.

sample_translations_comparison.source: But how is it even possible?
sample_translations_comparison.scaled_greedy: କିନ୍ତୁ କିଛି କି କେହାରି କ’ଣି କାରେ ?
sample_translations_comparison.linguistic_notes: The baseline's greedy output is a reasonable paraphrase this run. The scaled model's greedy decode is less fluent than its own beam-search output, illustrating why beam search matters even for short sentences.
